en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not pray Salāt in the valley of Al-Shaqrat’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from certain persons of our people who have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Salah (prayer) is not performed in al-Shuqrah valley.’”
